$comment: ST-6601 large steam sterilizer twin. Expected values in Maximo Monitor from the data sheet, the UK guidance limits and the IAPWS-IF97 steam equations; the controller sends only what it measures.

identification.model: STERIVAP HP 669-2 (ED: own integrated steam generator)
identification.description: Pass-through porous-load steam sterilizer, sterile services department, hospital
identification.type: Large steam sterilizer to EN 285, pre-vacuum (fractionated vacuum) porous-load cycles, jacketed chamber
identification.doors: Two vertical motor-driven doors (loading side in the clean packing room, unloading side in the sterile store)
identification.control: Two independent PLC systems (master-slave), each with its own chamber pressure and temperature sensors
identification.steam: Integrated electric steam generator fed with thermally degassed demineralised water

chamber.source: BMT STERIVAP HP brochure (EN, 2025), technical parameters, model 669-2 (dimensions h x w x d, sterilization modules, chamber volume, weight ED, max input / fuses ED).

programme.name: Wrapped materials 134 C / 7 min (porous load)
programme.source: Hold time 7 min: BMT STERIVAP HP brochure (EN, 2025), technical parameters, model 669-2 (standard validated programmes). Band 134-137 C and minimum holding time 3 min: HTM 01-01 Part C (England) Table 1 and para 2.66 / SHTM 01-01 Part C (Scotland) para 3.98. Controller set point 135.5 C: assumption: typical value, replace with the validated set point of your cycle.

saturation.source: Saturated steam temperature from the chamber pressure must agree with the measured temperatures within 2 C: HTM 01-01 Part C (England) Table 1 and para 2.66 / SHTM 01-01 Part C (Scotland) para 3.98. Sensor disagreement alert 1.0 K (half the 2 C tolerance): assumption: typical value, replace with your validation.

lethality.source: F0 = sum of 10^((T - 121.1)/10) x minutes: textbook definition (equivalent minutes at 121.1 C, z = 10 K).

tests.source: Vacuum leak test: <= 13 mbar rise in a 10 min hold after 5 min stabilisation, from below 70 mbar abs, weekly (SHTM 01-01 Part C paras 3.57-3.64, citing EN 285). Bowie-Dick daily, fail at 2 C (HTM 01-01 Part C 1.44). Equilibration time <= 15 s for chambers up to 800 l (SHTM 01-01 Part C 3.98). Early warning at 60 % of the leak limit: assumption: typical value, replace with your trend policy.

steam_quality.source: HTM 01-01 Part C paras 3.20, 3.221, 3.223 and the superheat test result (25 C). Supply nominal 4.0 bar g as assumed by the HTM superheat test. Supply alert 3.0 bar g: assumption: typical value, replace with the generator set point of your machine.

jacket.source: Jacket kept slightly hotter than the chamber so the walls do not condense: assumption: typical value, replace with the manufacturer's jacket set point.

vacuum.source: Deepest vacuum of the air-removal pulses and its alert: assumption: typical value, replace with the values recorded at validation (OQ).

utilities.source: Approx. max per cycle: steam 9 kg, water 0.08 m3, demineralised water 0.009 m3, electric energy 7.5 kWh (ED) and 0.4 kWh with central steam (the controls and pump, used here as the base load): BMT STERIVAP HP brochure (EN, 2025), technical parameters, model 669-2. hg at 5 bar abs (generator at 4 bar g) 2748.11 kJ/kg and hf at 20 C 83.9 kJ/kg: steam tables. Generator efficiency 0.95 and the alert ratios: assumption: typical value, replace with your own metered baseline.

door_seal.source: Door seal replacement interval in cycles: assumption: typical value, replace with the manufacturer's maintenance schedule (HTM 01-01 Part C 4.67: renew at the recommended interval).

demo.note: Demo only: one 134 C porous-load cycle (about 50 min on the real machine) runs in 90 s of real time, and the Bowie-Dick and leak test results are refreshed after every cycle so a fault shows within a few cycles.

groups.Test: Daily Bowie-Dick and weekly vacuum leak tests

failure_modes.$comment: Each failure mode: what degrades, how it shows, the rules that see it.

door_seal_wear.name: Door seal worn (air leaks in under vacuum)
door_seal_wear.symptoms: leak test rise up, air in the chamber: drain colder than steam at the measured pressure, Bowie-Dick fails, slow equilibration

ncg_in_steam.name: Non-condensable gases in the steam (feed water degassing failed)
ncg_in_steam.symptoms: same air signature in the chamber and a failed Bowie-Dick, but the leak test passes

jacket_overheat.name: Jacket too hot (jacket pressure set too high)
jacket_overheat.symptoms: jacket well above the chamber, steam in the chamber superheated: drain hotter than saturation

vacuum_pump_wear.name: Vacuum pump worn (air removal weak)
vacuum_pump_wear.symptoms: air-removal pulses do not reach their usual depth; cycles get longer

steam_supply_low.name: Steam supply pressure low (generator heater or supply fault)
steam_supply_low.symptoms: supply pressure low, chamber cannot reach the 134 C band: cycle fails

drain_trap_passing.name: Chamber or jacket drain trap passing steam
drain_trap_passing.symptoms: steam and energy per cycle above the data sheet maximum, energy per kg of steam normal

generator_scaling.name: Steam generator heaters scaled
generator_scaling.symptoms: more kWh per kg of steam than the steam tables allow
